feed_title: Orthopaedic Memory Foam Dog Bed Mattress, Edge to Edge Foam, Medium 82 x 70cm to XL 140 x 100cm, Washable Cover | PawLunova Ambleside
descriptionHtml:
Two foam layers. Foam to every edge. Sizes to 140 × 100cm.

Ambleside is an edge-to-edge memory foam dog mattress in Medium (82 × 70cm), Large (100 × 80cm) and Extra Large (140 × 100cm). Contouring foam over a firm base.

Watch where a dog lands when they drop onto a thin mattress. Plenty aim for a corner, feel the floor through it, and shuffle inward. By morning the outer band has never been slept on.

Foam here runs to all four edges. The top layer contours under them. The firmer base below stops them reaching the floor.

What they get

  • Two layers, not one: Contouring memory foam over a firmer foam base.
  • Foam to every edge: No soft rim to roll off and no dead space outside.
  • Nothing to step over: A level mattress they walk onto from any side.
  • A cover that comes off: Removable and washable to the sewn-in care label.

Best for: Side sleepers, sprawlers, and big dogs who outgrow a standard mattress.

Why it is worth the money

£109 for the Medium is real money, so here is where it goes. Two foam layers rather than one sheet floating in a bag. The orthopaedic memory foam core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee. Across the 1825 nights it covers, that is about 6p a night for the Medium, 8p for the Large and 9p for the Extra Large. And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

One warning on the Extra Large. At 140 × 100cm it needs 1.4 metres of clear floor. Measure the spot as well as the dog.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)
Medium82 × 70
Large100 × 80
Extra Large140 × 100

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Every centimetre is sleeping area. Compare their length against 82cm, 100cm and 140cm.

What does edge to edge actually mean?

Foam reaches the seam on all four sides, with no unsupported rim.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

A level two-layer foam mattress with nothing to climb. Ask your vet whether that suits your dog.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover comes off and washes to the sewn-in label. The foam never gets wet.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Give them the whole mattress, not just the middle.
